subject: Globally change typography for a shiny app

messages.author: fd98f08a6ab27905
messages.subject: Globally change typography for a shiny app
parts:
Hi,

I wonder what the most minimum-pain way is to change the typography style globally of a shiny web app.

Is it possible from R of do I have to style-tag every element?

Cheers

messages.author: 4be88a5fc86a040f
messages.subject: Re: Globally change typography for a shiny app
parts:
Quick and dirty way:
*{
    font-family: Times!important;
    color: #008c00!important;
}

messages.subject: Re: Globally change typography for a shiny app
parts:
Wow Kirill, that is pretty extreme. :) Even just applying those rules to body, instead of *; and not applying !important; should work for most things. (Though the color may vary)

body {
  font-family: Times;
}
